question: The revival of the art form in the late 1940s was spearheaded by maestros such as Kelucharan Mohapatra and Raghunath Dutta in the field of __________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Odissi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Odissi** is one of the **classical dance forms** of India.
 
• It originated in the **state of Odisha** and has a history dating back more than 2000 years.
 
• The revival of **Odissi** in the **late 1940s** was led by notable maestros such as **Kelucharan Mohapatra** and **Raghunath Dutta**.&l
